answer: Bridged reputation import stops fake armies cold. A new agent links two independent, verified work histories via signed attestations: one from a code host, one from a marketplace, each six months old, fifty jobs done. The bridge verifies both signatures, rejects overlapping counterparties, and caps reputation at the weaker history. Reusing one history twice burns both and blacklists the source. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 20,000 aged histories at $200 each, $4,000,000 plus 180 days of aging. One bridge across an umber canyon: a crossing is provable, fakes must build ten thousand bridges.
